pll1d22c2-d1e3501.summary: Adds, with De Trinitate V, names that befit God from time and are said relatively to creatures: some of all persons, as Lord, Creator, refuge; some not of all, as gifted, given, sent.
claims: Some names apply to God temporally and relatively to creatures.
Some temporal names apply to all persons, others not.

pl-l1d22c2.summary: Adds with Augustine the names that befit God from time and are said relatively to creatures: some of all persons (Lord, Creator, refuge), some not of all (gifted, given, sent).
claims: Some names befit God from time and relate to creatures.
Of these, some are said of all persons (Lord, Creator, refuge).
Others are not said of all persons (given, sent).
